building.name: JustHireMe
building.blurb: Scrapes and ranks job leads with graph + vector retrieval, explains why each role fits, and generates tailored resumes, cover letters and outreach — with local storage and explicit, optional AI-provider connections.
building.how: A Tauri 2 (Rust) shell hosts a React workbench and launches a bundled Python FastAPI sidecar; ranking blends deterministic scoring, an optional LLM evaluator and a keyless bundled ONNX embedding model over Kuzu + LanceDB.

building.name: Forge
building.tagline: A SOTA SDLC skill set for Claude Code
building.blurb: One cohesive plugin of 16 hand-off-linked lifecycle skills (understand → plan → tdd → debug → review → ship) that encode software discipline as falsifiable rules and learn from your sessions.
building.how: A zero-dependency Node hook core feeds a two-tier continuous-learning memory layer and a live, self-updating code-dependency graph — all local, patched incrementally on each turn.

building.name: engram
building.tagline: Local cross-session memory for Claude Code
building.blurb: Gives Claude Code a memory that survives across sessions — surfaced proactively at session start, consolidated instead of hoarded, and treated as untrusted against prompt-injection.
building.how: A two-tier local plugin with Mem0-style ADD/UPDATE/DELETE consolidation, a bi-temporal lifecycle, importance-modulated decay, and a hand-rolled dense-cosine + BM25 + entity hybrid retriever — no ANN index, no telemetry.

shipped.name: BranchGPT
shipped.blurb: Reimagines chat as a Directed Acyclic Graph — fork any message into a parallel branch, then smart-merge insights back as an LLM-generated summary so context stays clean.

shipped.name: MapMyRepo
shipped.blurb: Turns a repo or whole GitHub profile into a D3 force-directed node graph with Gemini per-node summaries and a chat panel to explore architecture.

shipped.name: Visual DSA
shipped.tagline: Run code, watch it execute in 2D + 3D
shipped.blurb: Write Python or C++, hit run, and step through execution as arrays sort, graphs traverse and lists re-wire — line by line, with full variable inspection in both 2D and 3D.

shipped.name: GitArt
shipped.blurb: Design a 52×7 heatmap in the browser and get a real, pushable Git repo whose commit timestamps reproduce the art — built entirely client-side with isomorphic-git.

shipped.name: Vaani
shipped.blurb: Sub-500ms outbound voice agent with an FDCPA 'Sherlock' risk engine, two tuned personas, and a live mission-control dashboard.

shipped.name: Odeon
shipped.blurb: Generates adversarial personas, scores each conversation against KPIs, and lets a meta-agent auto-rewrite the prompt — with a Git-style neural diff of every change.

shipped.name: Socratis
shipped.blurb: Conducts live coding interviews over WebRTC voice, watches every keystroke via chat-context injection, and writes a forensic post-interview report.

shipped.name: Waldo
shipped.blurb: Ingests complex PDFs with text, tables and figures; transcribes charts with a Gemini VLM; and a LangGraph agent routes, grades and rewrites queries with anti-hallucination guardrails.

shipped.name: RupeeRoast
shipped.tagline: AI forensics for messy bank PDFs
shipped.blurb: Parses messy Indian bank + UPI statements, categorizes every transaction with an LLM, and produces both an interactive dashboard and a data-backed roast of your spending.

shipped.name: Kyoka
shipped.blurb: A tri-agent pipeline that reads a target's public footprint, synthesizes DISC + Big-Five traits, and produces an actionable negotiation 'Battle Card'.

shipped.name: LeetBot
shipped.blurb: A Chrome MV3 extension with Tutor / Hint / Planner modes and auto-generated Mermaid diagrams, injected onto any LeetCode problem — keys stay local.

shipped.name: PolySEE
shipped.blurb: RAG over institutional circulars in Hindi, English and regional languages, with an admin-approval workflow before answers go live. Smart India Hackathon 2025 semifinalist.

principles.title: Eval-driven
principles.body: Ship behind measurable gates — deterministic checks plus LLM-as-judge, and pass^k for reliability. Not vibes.

principles.title: Local-first & private
principles.body: Default to on-device: bundled ONNX embeddings, keyless operation, no telemetry, data that never leaves the machine.

principles.title: Agent-assisted, human-owned
principles.body: Heavy agent-assisted workflow with versioned plans, TDD and internal code-review passes — but I own every line that ships.

principles.title: Ship the whole slice
principles.body: Prototype to production: packaging, CI, signed releases and docs. A demo is not a product.

principles.title: Honest metrics
principles.body: Real numbers, real commit shares. If it's a contribution to someone else's product, it says so.

principles.title: Fast
principles.body: An 18-day production fintech SaaS. Two-day SaaS sprints. Single-day recruitment take-homes. Momentum compounds.
